semantics.legalProvinceIds: Source province hre=yes through snapshot date; rendered land only. This is a game-defined imperial legal membership flag, not a survey of every lore claim.
semantics.allLegalProvinceIds: Same HRE flag set before water/wasteland/excluded/no-pixel filtering.
semantics.memberTags: Active countries whose actual owned source capital has hre=yes. Capital ownership conflicts remain unresolved; no centroid or alternate capital substitution.
semantics.memberOwnedProvinceIds: All visible land owned by confirmed member countries, including land outside the HRE legal flag.
semantics.controlledProvinceIds: All visible land whose source controller is a confirmed member; not merely the emperor country holdings.
semantics.externalHeldLegalProvinceIds: HRE-flagged land owned by a confirmed nonmember. This is the supported external legal-territory subset, not every diplomatic or mission claim.
semantics.emperorOwnedProvinceIds: The emperor country own visible land, separately from the entire collective imperial territory.
semantics.additionalClaimProvinceIds: Empty means not researched. National cores, permanent claims, mission rewards, alliances and subject status are not automatic claims of the whole Empire.
semantics.temporal: 1444 baseline only. Later membership, ownership, emperors and legal claims need separately dated evidence; an emperor change never transfers all imperial land to that emperor.
semantics.verification: Static mod-history extraction checked against the base atlas. No EU4 engine, setup effects or on-actions executed.
